LanguageData.VFEC_Apparel_CenturionArmor.comps.0.desc: Toggle buffing nearby allies, turn off when not in combat if performance is a concern
LanguageData.VFEC_Apparel_CenturionArmor.description: A carefully designed and decorated set of armor made from a series of reinforced metal or wooden sheets, forming somewhat of a carapace without sacrificing too much dexterity. Such armor is known to embolden one's mental fortitude.
LanguageData.VFEC_Apparel_CenturionArmor.label: centurion armor

LanguageData.VFEC_Toga.description: A semicircular, open-bottomed garment designed to cover the entire body and shoulders. While similar to tribal clothing the toga is generally made with a more delicate touch and presents itself as dignified everyday wear.
LanguageData.VFEC_Toga.label: toga
